Interface StationDefinition

All Known Subinterfaces:
JmodelStationDefinition
All Known Implementing Classes:
CommonModel, JSimGraphModel, JSIMModel
public interface StationDefinition
Created by IntelliJ IDEA. User: OrsotronIII Date: 27-mag-2005 Time: 9.52.46 This interface provides methods for editing of set of stations for JSIM models. Each station is assigned a search key that can be used to retrieve each parameter.
